note: NCB only: National Commercial Bank is Jamaica's largest bank and card issuer; Scotiabank Jamaica's and JMMB's card schedules weren't reached in this pass. NCB's card rates and charges (personal cards, effective 1 December 2025), read in full, with its fee guide effective 1 September 2026 for the two annual fees it changed: its five personal cards, the Visa Classic, Visa Platinum and Mastercard Platinum Travel in Jamaican dollars and the Mastercard and Mastercard Platinum Travel in US dollars, each with its joining and annual fee for the primary card (the Visa Classic's 4,800 and the Mastercard Platinum (JMD)'s 14,800 from the September 2026 guide, the others from the December 2025 schedule), its unsecured annual interest rate range, written at the top with the bottom as the lowest (the Mastercard's secured rate of 15% isn't written), a cash advance fee of 7.5% (plus GCT, at a rate not stated, so not added), a cross-border conversion fee of 1.25% to 3%, written at 3%, a monthly minimum payment of 4% of the statement balance, and its late payment, over-limit and returned cheque charges (which include GCT). No grace period is stated.
